description: Detached panel windows (Phase 3, ADR-0013): custom title bar window controls only, plus core_connection, window_redock_panel (re-dock itself) the separate VS Code window commands (ADR-0043: a detached VS Code panel can still open it) and the native open / save dialogs (`dialog:allow-open`, `dialog:allow-save` for File → Save As…, for Browse… in panels). They load the same frontend and talk to the core over the RPC protocol; layout and geometry are driven by the main window.
